summary: In-lab sleep study: OSA symptoms with severe COPD on home oxygen

request.clinical_notes: 68-year-old referred by pulmonology. Wife reports loud nightly snoring and pauses in breathing. Epworth Sleepiness Scale 14. He has COPD on 2 L home oxygen at night. Requesting attended polysomnography with oxygen titration.
request.document_text: PULMONARY FUNCTION TEST SUMMARY. FEV1 38 percent predicted, FEV1/FVC 0.52. Interpretation: severe obstructive ventilatory defect consistent with COPD GOLD grade 3.
